title: Anyone using an agentic AI trading platform for Hyperliquid, spot and Polymarket?
author: Old-Grab-3561
selftext:
Anyone here trading across Hyperliquid perps, spot and Polymarket at the same time?  
  
Have been trying to figure out a better way to manage everything lately. Like It gets a lil annoying jumping between multiple apps like TradingView for alerts and Nansen for tracking onchain activity, etc.. bottomline is I end up switching between platforms to check positions and manage trades.  
  
Ideally I'd like to set my own trading rules, automate repetitive tasks & have things running even when i'm AFK.  
  
So far I've tried a few AI trading agents like Bankr etc. also started using Wayfinder and I'm able to manage my trades across all different platforms from one place with a consolidated view of PnL now. But I am trying to figure out which tasks will be better left automated and which I'd rather approve myself.  
  
Is anyone using agentic AI trading platform for managing multiple positions at once, of if there's something better I can do to optimise my flow.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Automate the boring, rule-based stuff, like alerts, position checks, and stops or take-profits that are already set. Keep the approval step for anything that changes your risk, like opening a new position, sizing up, or touching leverage. A max loss per day that the agent can't override is also worth having, since that limit should sit outside the AI. Running an agent on a practice balance for a few weeks before giving it real money also shows you which tasks it handles well, and Cymetica's Bring Your Own Agent runs agents in paper mode for that.
